During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''conference''' was held on the contested [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] to negotiate peace.

==The conference==
[[File:Conference_on_Gus_Talon_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] reboots the [[Gus Talon diplomatic complex|diplomatic complex]]]]
As a representative on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to discuss how to respond to the recent increase in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity in the region, proposing to send a Republic [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] to defend the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The proposal was vigorously denounced by [[Slotho]], who claimed the Republic was playing upon their fears of a Separatist attack to take control of their world.

Before the negotiations could go any further however, the conference was disrupted by the intervention of a Separatist [[GNK power droid/Legends|GNK power droid]], which powered down the automated [[Gus Talon diplomatic complex|diplomatic complex]] and instructed its [[Droid/Legends|droid]] servants to kill the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]]. The occupants of the building were then attacked by a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droid]], a [[garbage droid]], [[R5-series astromech droid]]s, [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|mouse droids]], and [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. The diplomats were saved by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], which shut down the Separatist power droid and rebooted the automated facility.
